# The Ski Monster

> > Boston-based ski and snowboard shop offering expert-tested gear from Armada, Blizzard, Nordica, Salomon, Burton and 40+ brands, plus comprehensive fitting guides and equipment tutorials.

The Ski Monster started as a college startup in 2007 and now operates a retail location at 60 Canal St in Boston, MA. They specialize in curated ski and snowboard equipment with expert testing, detailed buyer's guides, and technical resources for boot fitting, binding adjustment, and gear maintenance.

## Key Topics

- Ski boot fitting
- All-mountain skis
- Ski bindings (Look, Marker, Tyrolia)
- Burton snowboards & Step On system
- BOA closure systems
- DIN settings & forward pressure
- Mondo point sizing
- Ski construction & materials
- Rocker and camber profiles
- Armada, Blizzard, Nordica, Salomon
- Shin bang prevention
- Boot liner pack-out
- Expert gear testing
- Boston ski shop

## Ski Boot Fitting Guides

- [The Ultimate Ski Boot Fitting Guide](https://theskimonster.com/blogs/posts/the-ultimate-ski-boot-fitting-guide-how-to-get-boots-that-feel-good-and-ski-better): Comprehensive boot fitting guide: assessment, comfort & performance tips
- [Why Your Ski Boots Hurt (and How to Fix It)](https://theskimonster.com/blogs/posts/ski-boot-fitting-why-do-your-ski-boots-hurt): Boot pain diagnosis & solutions: mobility, strength, liners & footbeds
- [Ski Boot Sizing Chart](https://theskimonster.com/blogs/posts/ski-boot-sizing-chart): Mondo point sizing chart for finding correct ski boot size
- [Shin Bang Explained](https://theskimonster.com/blogs/posts/shin-bang-explained): Shin bang causes & solutions: boot sizing, footbeds, flex & biomechanics
- [Ski Boots Feel Loose? Here's Why](https://theskimonster.com/blogs/posts/ski-boots-feel-loose-here-s-why-and-what-to-do-about-it): Troubleshooting loose ski boots: liner pack-out & body adaptation fixes
- [Everything You Need to Know About BOA Ski Boots](https://theskimonster.com/blogs/posts/everything-you-need-to-know-about-boa-ski-boots-complete-deep-dive): BOA vs buckles comparison: shell & cuff placement pros/cons explained
